title: FVSCHEDULE rejects logical principals, coerces scalar or single-cell text schedules, and rejects text inside multi-cell schedules
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, FVSCHEDULE(principal, schedule) rejects a logical principal with #VALUE! (while coercing numeric text), coerces numeric text when schedule is a direct scalar or single-cell reference, treats blank cells in a range schedule as 0 while rejecting text or logicals inside a multi-cell range or array with #VALUE!, and multiplies principal * prod(1 + r_i) in binary64. Matches 2,857/2,857 full-bank FVSCHEDULE rows.
basis: Measured across all 2,857 full-bank FVSCHEDULE rows in Excel 16.0.20527 (CalcFunc-Evidence bank2-answers-fvschedule-{scalar,more,special}.json), prefix_metadata (row 364), and f3_financial (row 6).
